annotations.title: Zero-Trust OFAC SDN & Global Sanctions Entity Screening

description: Screens a corporate entity or individual counterparty against the U.S. Treasury OFAC Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) and consolidated sanctions registries using exact identifier matching (LEI/CIK/CRN) and Jaro-Winkler fuzzy phonetic resolution, returning a compliance verdict and SHA-256 Merkle audit proof. Use when: verifying whether a specific company, vessel, wallet counterparty, or individual is sanctioned before onboarding or settlement. Do not use when: retrieving macro-level weekly sanctions policy trends (use get_sovereign_policy_brief instead) or drafting regulatory comment letters on FinCEN/OFAC rulemakings (use synthesize_regulatory_docket instead). Behavior: Read-only, deterministic compliance check ($0.50 USD per call via HTTP header x-api-key or x-payment-token; returns an x402/MPP paymentChallenge without charging if credentials are omitted).

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 two-letter jurisdiction code of incorporation or residence (e.g., "US", "RU", "IR", "GB"; default: "US").

entity_name.description: Full legal name of the corporation, financial institution, vessel, or individual to screen (e.g., "Vnesheconombank", "Blackstone Inc.").

fuzzy_threshold.description: Jaro-Winkler string similarity threshold between 0.60 (broad alias capture) and 0.95 (strict match) required to flag a match (default: 0.85).

registration_number.description: Optional 20-character Legal Entity Identifier (LEI), Corporate Registration Number (CRN), or 10-digit SEC Central Index Key (CIK) for exact registry matching.

name: screen_ofac_entity

receipt.description: Cryptographic payment or API key settlement receipt ID.

verdict.description: Forensic sanctions screening result and cryptographic proof.

confidence_score.description: Normalized match similarity score from 0.0 to 1.0.

match_detected.description: True if entity matched an active OFAC SDN or blocked person entry.

matched_sdn_id.description: OFAC SDN registry identifier if matched, otherwise null.

matched_via.description: Matching mechanism used (EXACT_NAME, ALIAS_PHONETIC, FUZZY_JARO_WINKLER, or NONE).

merkle_proof.description: Cryptographic Merkle tree inclusion branch hashes.

sanctions_program.description: Applicable OFAC sanctions program code (e.g., UKRAINE-EO13662, IRAN, SDGT) or null.

statutory_proof_hash.description: SHA-256 statutory audit digest of the screening event.

title: Zero-Trust OFAC SDN & Global Sanctions Entity Screening
